svg.title: Marrow-Song: Bead-string notation
svg.desc: Marrow-Song (1D): the group's song as beads on strands across a vertebral membrane. Each slot holds one brother's phrase of four beads, height for pitch, a large bead for the accent; the knots between slots glow green for a smooth join, amber for a rough one, grey for a break. A play-head of light runs along the song, and the last bead of the verse sits home at the lowest height. Each player's tray of spare phrases waits below.
